FIBW.description: Fiber Wall Section Division (FIBW). Defines the fiber-based section division of a wall: the per-fiber material names/colors (up to 6), the base fiber/rebar entries (FIBW_BASE), and the optional monitored-fiber set. Each FIBW_BASE entry is either a fiber region (OPT_IS_REBAR=false, requiring POINT_Y/POINT_Z polygon coordinates) or a rebar (OPT_IS_REBAR=true, using AREA and CENTER_Y/Z).

NAME.description: Name of the fiber wall section division.

WALL_ID.description: Wall ID that this fiber section division is assigned to.

STOR_KEY.description: Story key that this fiber section division belongs to.

ASSIGN_TYPE.description: Assign type code for the fiber wall section division.

FIMP_NAME.description: Fiber (inelastic) material names, one per fiber-material slot. Each non-empty name must reference an existing FIMP (fiber inelastic material property); empty strings are allowed for unused slots.

FIMP_COLOR.description: Display color (RGB) for each of the 6 fiber-material slots. Optional; each component defaults to 0 when omitted.

FIBW_BASE.description: Base fiber/rebar entries composing the wall section division. Required and must be assigned.

FIBR_BASE_KEY.description: Key identifying this base fiber/rebar entry.

REBAR_NAME.description: Rebar name associated with this entry (used when OPT_IS_REBAR=true).

CENTER_Y.description: Center Y coordinate of the fiber/rebar.

CENTER_Z.description: Center Z coordinate of the fiber/rebar.

FIBER_MATL_ID.description: Fiber material ID (slot index/id into the FIMP material set).

OPT_IS_REBAR.description: True if this entry is a rebar; false if it is a fiber region. When false, POINT_Y and POINT_Z are required and define the fiber polygon.

POINT_Y.description: [OPT_IS_REBAR=false] Polygon Y coordinates of the fiber region. Required when OPT_IS_REBAR is false; ignored for rebar entries. Paired element-wise with POINT_Z (shorter length is used).

POINT_Z.description: [OPT_IS_REBAR=false] Polygon Z coordinates of the fiber region. Required when OPT_IS_REBAR is false; ignored for rebar entries. Paired element-wise with POINT_Y (shorter length is used).

OPT_MONITORED_FIBER.description: True if a monitored fiber set is defined. MONITORED_FIBER is applied only when this is true.

MONITORED_FIBER.description: Monitored fiber indices (fixed set of 8). Applied only when OPT_MONITORED_FIBER is true.
